exclusion_technique: Replace an existing AppStream fleet image or session-script archive while retaining its role
review_evidence: AWS UpdateFleet permits ImageArn on a RUNNING Always-On or On-Demand fleet while keeping its existing IamRoleArn; new instances use the new image. The active PassRole UpdateFleet route changes the role, so it does not cover image substitution. A definite principal edge needs one exact fleet and role, source UpdateFleet on that fleet and any required image resource, an image the source can control and the fleet can use, and a future instance/session execution path. The current inventory has fleet-role details but does not prove image ownership or control. AWS UpdateFleet API and Update a Fleet with a New Image guide.

exclusion_technique: Create a container fleet with a passed role and controlled container group
review_evidence: AWS CreateContainerFleet requires FleetRoleArn and a named container group definition to deploy containers. The active CreateBuild plus CreateFleet route does not authorize this separate API. A definite role path needs exact group definition/image ownership, source CreateContainerGroupDefinition and CreateContainerFleet permissions, PassRole to GameLift, deployment and role credential availability in a controlled container. Current collector does not join those facts; AWS CreateContainerFleet API.

exclusion_technique: Create an EC2 fleet with a passed role and a pre-existing controlled build or script
review_evidence: A source may choose an existing game build or script in CreateFleet without CreateBuild, but its control of that exact executable and a runnable startup path are not established by the fleet and PassRole grants. The active route covers a newly created/uploadable build only. Need exact artifact-control, fleet request and role joins before a separate edge; AWS CreateFleet and CreateBuild APIs.
